description: A white T‑shirt lies on a wooden table in front of you, with a red cloth hanging in the background. The left hand reaches in and lifts part of the shirt while the right hand steadies it, then both hands spread the T‑shirt flat and smooth it; next the left hand folds one side inward and the right hand helps align the edge, after which both hands fold the shirt lengthwise into a long rectangle and then fold it over again into a compact bundle, releasing it on the table.
